name: lib_compactSpace_exists_lt_dist_lt
statement: {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (u : ℕ → Y) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ m n : ℕ, m < n ∧ dist (u m) (u n) < ε
closed: ∀ {Y : Type*} [MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (u : ℕ → Y) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε), ∃ m n : ℕ, m < n ∧ dist (u m) (u n) < ε
informal: Pigeonhole in a compact metric space: any sequence has two terms u m, u n with m < n at distance < ε (from sequential compactness). Promoted from Mathlib2.top_expanding_compact_isometry_aux2 (the same argument is used in top_isometry_compact_surjective).
type: ∀ {Y : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y] (u : ℕ → Y) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ m n, m < n ∧ dist (u m) (u n) < ε
